answer: Each identity books one 20-minute slot on a shared teleoperation rig and drives its robot arm to arrange ivory tiles on a velvet tray into a falcon outline seeded by its key. Verifiers match the tile order and arm telemetry against the seed record; a failed or replayed attempt revokes the slot. Only 30 rigs exist, so 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 separate slots: 333 rig-hours at $15 each ($15,000), queued over weeks with no parallel speedup. Trade-off: rig downtime also caps honest admission.
